Welcome to ParentText! This chatbot has been designed with and for parents. Before we get started, let's make sure this programme is right for you:
Are you 18 years old or older?

swift_prescreen.messages.1.text: Are you a nurse or someone working at a clinic in Delft or Ceres?
We would like to know how you found out about this programme. Did you:
See a poster on the wall of your local clinic?
Hear about it from someone working in the clinic or a community healthcare worker?
Get a paper flyer from the clinic or with your medication?
See something on social media (e.g. Facebook, WhatsApp)?
Which clinic were you at when you found out about ParentText?
swift_prescreen.choices.8.text: I was not at a clinic

ret_consent_data.msg:
Thank you! We are testing this programme to see if it works. 
✅ Participating in this study is optional. 
✅ Your personal information is safe and private. 
✅ Your name and information will not be public, but your responses will be kept and used by researchers to learn how to support families like yours. 
✅ The information you share may also be combined with other families’ experiences so that we can understand how these programmes work across the world.
Would you like to participate in the study to help us learn how we can support parents like you in South Africa? 🇿🇦
Yes, I want to participate in the study

🥳 Welcome to our study! If you decide to join, you will be invited to complete 3 surveys. 

🌱 The surveys will ask you questions about your life and your relationship with your child. 

💬  After completing the first survey, you will receive ParentText on WhatsApp from this number.

✏️ 1 month later, you will be asked to complete a 2nd survey. 

✏️ 3 months later, you will receive a 3rd survey.

🤐 If there are any questions that you feel uncomfortable answering, you do not have to answer them.

❌ You can stop when you want. Just type {STOP}.

📱  WiFi: Check your local free WiFi hotspots here: https://www.westerncape.gov.za/site-page/wcg-wi-fi-hotspots (Tip: If you get a library card, you can access more WiFi at library hotspots! Your local mall might also have WiFi).

Please read this information carefully: {ret_consent_link}
Press YES if you have read and understand the above document, agree with the messages, and give consent to participate in the study. Type "EXIT" if you do not want to participate.
ret_consent_data.metadata.description:

EXIT needs to be consistent with "exit_option"

💚Thanks! Now we would like to ask you a few questions about your relationship with Your {Age Group}.
How often in the past week did you play games or do other fun activities with Your {Age Group}?
How often in the past week did you praise Your {Age Group} when they behaved well?
How often in the past week did Your {Age Group} not obey or it was difficult to make them obey?

😔 There are days in our lives when we feel sad and down. 

Sometimes it's because things don't go as planned. 
Sometimes it's because something bad happened. 
Sometimes it is because we are too stressed. 

💚 Some of these questions are difficult to answer so please try your best. 
💚 There are no right or wrong answers.
How often in the past week have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless?
How often in the past week did you have little interest or pleasure in doing things?
How often in the past week did you actively participate in activities with Your {Age Group}, such as playing, sharing books, or helping with homework?
How often in the past week were you involved in making decisions regarding Your {Age Group}'s education, health, and overall well-being?
How often in the past week did you show Your {Age Group} affection or love?

🌱 The last questions are about Your {Age Group}, their behaviour, and their communication with you.

💚Again, some of these questions might be difficult to answer or even think about, but they are important. Please share honestly so that we can support you.

😔 If Your {Age Group} has been exposed to something sexual, it is important that it has been reported. If it hasn't been reported, or you need more support, please call Childline on 116. They are there to help you and Your {Age Group} with this very difficult experience.

🌱 The last questions are about Your {Age Group}, their behaviour, and their communication with you.
